VEON is a Nasdaq-listed global digital operator that serves more than 150 million customers with connectivity and 230 million monthly active users with digital services in some of the world’s most exciting frontier markets.

Operating across 5 countries that are home to nearly 520 million people, more than 6% of the world’s population, VEON transforms lives through technology driven services that empower individuals and drive economic growth.

With VEON's Digital Operator/AI 1440 vision and strategy, the VEON Group of companies redefine the engagement that telecom operators have with their customers, providing the best digital experience to customers up to 1440 minutes in a day. We transform not only the daily experience of the final users but also support the growth of enterprises and industries as a whole, using cutting-edge technologies in AI, big-data and cloud services to serve our business customers.

This is all underpinned by a commitment to sustainability, ensuring VEON’s operations are run safely and ethically while fostering digital entrepreneurship and greater digital skills and literacy in the communities in which VEON operates. VEON’s values-based approach works to strengthen trust by building a responsible and sustainable business that benefits customers, employees, communities, and shareholders.
VEON’s international leadership team is drawn from experienced executives from around the world and has been led by CEO Kaan Terzioğlu since July 2021.
You will have direct exposure to the business and be part of a team of lawyers based in VEON’s Dubai Headquarters.

Reporting to the Deputy General Counsel - Sanctions, Litigation and Commercial, you will be providing support for a wide variety of functions and divisions within VEON, including Group Executives and OpCo Management teams.

d: The Rewards Operations Specialist runs the day-to-day operation of the stc pay Bahrain app's rewards programs so that every eligible customer receives the right reward, on time, at the right cost. The role covers card cashback, points earning and redemption, in-app promotional campaigns and partner offers.
q: Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Marketing, Information Systems or a related field.
3–5 years of experience in loyalty, rewards, campaign operations or payments operations, ideally in fintech, banking or telecom.
Hands-on experience with a rewards or campaign management platform and card transaction data.
Strong Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups); SQL for data checks and reporting is a strong advantage.
Familiarity with BI tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Understanding of card payments: authorisation, settlement, MCC codes, refunds and chargebacks.
Working knowledge of CBB regulations and consumer protection principles.
r: Configure approved cashback, points and promotional campaigns in the rewards engine: eligibility rules, segments, caps, merchant lists, dates and budgets.
Write test cases and run UAT with Product and QA before every launch; sign off go-live readiness.
Coordinate in-app content, push notifications and terms and conditions with Marketing and Legal.
x: Monitor daily reward accruals, credits and redemptions against campaign rules and budget.
Detect and fix failed, delayed, duplicate or wrongly calculated rewards; run manual adjustments under approved limits.
Process reward reversals for cancelled transactions, refunds and chargebacks.
Pause or adjust campaigns quickly when budget, abuse or technical issues require it.
Reconcile reward liabilities with Finance daily and monthly, including points and merchant-funded offers.
Validate partner and merchant invoices, settlement files and funding contributions.
Track campaign spend versus budget and flag variances early.
Work with Fraud and Risk to detect reward abuse such as multiple accounts, self-dealing and suspicious transaction patterns.
Keep campaigns aligned with CBB rules, internal policies and published terms and conditions.
Maintain maker-checker controls, audit trails and documentation for every configuration change.
Act as second-level support for Customer Care on reward disputes and complaints.
Resolve escalated cases within SLA and identify root causes of repeat complaints.
Keep FAQs and Care scripts up to date for each live campaign.
Produce daily, weekly and post-campaign reports on participation, rewards issued, cost and ROI.
Recommend rule, process and automation improvements to raise efficiency and cut errors.
Write and maintain SOPs for all rewards operations processes.

Compliance Requirements TranslationLiaise with local compliance teams across global regions to develop a deep understanding of the security technical requirements under various regulatory frameworks (e.g., EU DORA, Turkey CMB/Tubitak, Hong Kong SFC). Translate compliance requirements into actionable security platform product requirements and technical solutions.

Audit & Certification SupportLead or participate in security audit preparation for compliance entities, including internal audits, external audits, penetration test report reviews, and audit evidence compilation and delivery — ensuring accuracy and timeliness of all audit materials.

Security Operations GovernanceDrive the implementation of security policies, processes, and standards across compliance entities, covering control domains such as vulnerability management, log monitoring (SIEM), antivirus coverage, access rights reviews, and security awareness training.

License Application SupportParticipate in the security-related components of financial license applications across regional compliance entities; author technical documentation including security architecture descriptions, control matrices, and risk assessments.

Security Metrics ManagementAssist in establishing and maintaining security operations metrics frameworks for each compliance entity (coverage rates, SLAs, compliance rates, etc.); produce regular security operations reports.

Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field; 5+ years of experience in information security, with at least 3 years focused on security compliance governance, security auditing, or security operations.

Solid familiarity with mainstream security compliance frameworks and regulatory requirements such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS, and GDPR; knowledge of financial industry security regulations (e.g., DORA, MAS TRM) is a plus.

Strong security technical foundation with the ability to understand the working principles of security products and controls including SIEM, vulnerability scanning tools (Tenable/Orca/Nessus), EDR/antivirus, WAF, and IAM.
Hands-on experience participating in security audits (internal or external), with the ability to independently complete audit evidence preparation, control gap analysis, and remediation tracking.
Fluent in both Chinese and English; able to read regulatory documents in English, produce security compliance technical documentation, and communicate seamlessly with overseas teams.
Strong cross-functional communication and project execution skills; able to collaborate effectively across multiple time zones and cultural backgrounds.
Prior security compliance experience at a cryptocurrency exchange, payment institution, large internet company, or fintech firm.
Experience building multi-region / multi-site security compliance frameworks (not limited to a single region).
Familiarity with security platform/product development; ability to derive platform feature requirements from compliance needs.
Experience as an ISO 27001 internal auditor or participation in a SOC 2 Type II audit.
Holds certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, or ISO 27001 LA/LI.
Direct hands-on experience with specific regional regulatory frameworks such as DORA, Tubitak, or SFC.
